name: cited_oracle_inputs: REJECT vault:// source_url with shortform OID (6-hex)
expected_error_detail: schema_error: source_url vault scheme OID must be full 64-hex sha256
__comment: Any vault://<bundle>/<resource>/<oid> written to a receipt MUST carry the full
64-hex sha256 OID form: oid-[a-f0-9]{64}. Shortform (here 6-hex) is rejected.
The OID check in standaloneVerifyEntry fires BEFORE the hash-integrity check.
To keep that ordering falsifiable, value_hash here is the CORRECT hash of raw_value
so if the OID guard were absent the vector would pass integrity -- making the
OID guard the sole gate catching this vector.
notes: source_url carries oid-7f3a2e (6-hex shortform). Full 64-hex sha256 is required.
The shortform tolerance window in spec Section 1.8 applies to CLI parser input only;
it never reaches a signed receipt.
value_hash is the correct hash of raw_value so the OID check is the sole failure gate.
Verifier MUST reject with schema_error before reaching hash-integrity checks.
